review_rules: Aldmer and Altmer must remain historically distinct labels; do not project later Altmeri institutions unchanged onto ancient Aldmeri society
Altmeri social ideals such as Alaxon should distinguish prescriptive doctrine from observed lived practice
Psijic accounts of the Old Ways, time and metaphysics retain institutional/source provenance rather than becoming universal truth
Competing accounts of Aldmeris and early elven origins should coexist where evidence conflicts
Summerset's political isolation/opening must retain era-specific context
Cross-link existing Altmer, Aldmer, Summerset, Auridon, Alinor, Artaeum, Crystal Tower, Psijic Order, Sapiarchs, Ayrenn, Vanus Galerion and Mannimarco records
